ValidationRule.description: SVC-02: a Technical case cannot be assigned to a user (engineer) unless Estimated Effort is above zero. Queues are allowed. Bypassed by the Bypass Validation Rules custom permission (HES Data Loader) for data loads.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Validation_Rules), RecordType.DeveloperName = "Technical", ISCHANGED(OwnerId), NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:User.Id)), OR(ISBLANK(Estimated_Effort__c), Estimated_Effort__c <= 0) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter an estimated effort above zero before assigning this case to an engineer.
